additional_info.subject: ID0484031-DC/Si-D/IT- [MP / R9 170002562] Check on logs CRM:02832000871
additional_info.body:
Dear Rosita,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support.
Following a review of the provided information and a deeper check, we can confirm that the charging session you mentioned was terminated by the EV, not due to a charger issue.
Currently, no errors are present in the system. However, both outlets appear to be set as "inoperative" by your company, as indicated in the pictures:
We encountered a minor issue with a cable temperature sensor. This problem occurred after the charging session you mentioned (around 17:47 CU time) and was subsequently resolved autonomously by the charger.
We will continue to monitor the charger's performance over the coming days. Should this issue reoccur, we will take the necessary action to resolve it. Otherwise, we will proceed with closing the ticket.
Best regards,
Ivan
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0484031-DC/Si-D/IT- [MP / R9 170002562] Check on logs CRM:02832000871
additional_info.body:
Hello and thank you for the feedback,
We didn’t set the
outlets as "inoperative", so it’s not correct.
Also, on the events of the charger we constantly see “CU not reachable” followed by “CU up again”, and the charger is in status unavailable on the Sifinity portal.
Regarding the client’s unsuccessful charging sessions:
The first started at 4:12:17 PM and finished at 4:16:28 PM CU TIME;
The second started at 4:15:15 PM and finished at 4:16:28 PM CU TIME;
The third started at 4:17:21 PM and finished at 17:23:22 PM CU TIME;
The fourth started at 4:26:07 PM and finished at 17:41:41 PM CU TIME.
For none of these sessions there was energy delivery, also the charging sessions remained active after the interruption and the removal of the connector.
Then we rebooted the charger and the client charged correctly between 4:41:59 PM and 4:47:52 PM CU TIME.
Since we see a few connection issues, and the charging sessions that took place before these were also unsuccessful, are you sure the recharge was interrupted by the EV?
With best regards,
Rosita Abate

additional_info.subject: ID0484031-DC/Si-D/IT- [MP / R9 170002562] Check on logs CRM:02832000871
additional_info.body:
Dear Rosita,
Thank you for your follow-up.
After a deeper investigation, I confirm that we encountered charging sessions stopped by the EV and others stopped due to communication loss between the EVSE and the EV. Given that the charger
MP / R9 170002562 / 1jxU6Y
shows no errors, the issue likely originated with the EV for all sessions.
Regarding the “inoperative” status of the outlet, I confirm the observations in our system, as depicted in the pictures attached to the previous email. In Sifinity, both the charger and outlets are displayed as “unavailable”.
Furthermore, our review of Sifinity revealed several OCPP connection problems. While these are typically related to Ethernet issues, I prefer to transfer this ticket to our Specialist Team for a deeper examination in this specific case.
We will get back to you as soon as we have more information.
Best regards,
Ivan
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team
